components.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar on desktop, slide-over drawer on mobile. Contains recent chat sessions.
components.top_nav: Contains Brand Logo/Name and an English/Hindi Language Toggle button (e.g., [EN | HI]).
components.chat_area: Main scrollable area for chat bubbles. Background should be slightly off-white (#F9F8F6).
components.message_bubble_user: Solid primary color (#2D6A4F) background with white text, aligned right.
components.message_bubble_ai: White background with a subtle border (#E5E3DB) and soft shadow (shadow-sm), aligned left. Supports markdown rendering for disease name, precautions, and fertilizer effects.
components.quick_reply_chips: Horizontal scrollable list of chips (e.g., 'Show Precautions', 'Effect on Soil') below AI responses.
components.input_area: Fixed at the bottom. Contains a text input/textarea, an image upload button (icon: image or camera), and a send button (icon: send or arrow-right).

demo_disease_leaf.description: A green leaf with brown spots on it, used as a mock image upload for leaf blight disease detection.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons and chips should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and darken/lighten on hover.
motion_and_interactions.typing_indicator: Use three animating dots for the AI processing state.
motion_and_interactions.image_upload_preview: Show a thumbnail of the uploaded image above the input field with a clear 'X' to remove it.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-image-button', data-testid='send-message-button', data-testid='language-toggle').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text colors meet WCAG AA standards against their backgrounds.

special_instructions_for_agent: Build a single-page React app with a chat interface structure.
Ensure the language toggle actually updates the mock content (e.g., switches placeholder text and AI responses between English and Hindi).
When an image is uploaded and sent, simulate a delay (typing indicator) and then respond with a structured AI message containing: Disease Name, Precautions, and Fertilizer/Medicine effects.
Use the provided image URL to mock a user's uploaded image if they don't upload a real one.
Use standard Shadcn components (Button, Input, Textarea, ScrollArea, Tooltip, Sheet for mobile menu, etc.).
Implement 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in the HTML/CSS.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header; use solid surface or glassmorphism.
Include data-testid on every clickable element.
